name: TouchDesigner
product: TouchDesigner by Derivative

evidence.says: Derivative's September 1, 2026 release provides a dedicated Apple Silicon macOS installer for TouchDesigner 2025.33230 alongside an Intel installer.

name: Netflix
product: User-created Netflix website wrapper generated by Todd Ditchendorf’s Fluid

evidence.says: Fluid creates a local Mac application from a URL and a user-chosen name, which explains the FluidApp2 namespace of the scanned Netflix bundle.
Netflix’s Mac instructions direct viewers to netflix.com through a web browser.

limitation: The specific user-generated wrapper was not available to inspect.
notes: The Homebrew cask hint is for a separate third-party Netflix wrapper.

name: Red Giant Application Manager
product: Red Giant Application Manager by Red Giant / Maxon

evidence.says: Maxon announced on June 22, 2021 that the Maxon App replaced Red Giant Application Manager.
Maxon’s current guide calls the Red Giant utility redundant and recommends uninstalling it.

limitation: The final standalone Red Giant Application Manager version and its Mac architecture were not established.
notes: The successor is Maxon App and needs its own compatibility record.

name: Logophile
product: Logophile electronic dictionary browser by dicwizard.jp

evidence.says: The developer says development, sales and support ended on December 31, 2022, and confirms there will be no further updates or bug fixes.

limitation: The final Mac release and its architecture were not confirmed.
notes: Previously registered users retain permission to use their licensed copies.

name: EVKey
product: EVKey Vietnamese keyboard for Mac by Lâm Quang Minh

evidence.says: The developer’s Mac download is EVKeyMac.zip version 3.3.10, whose EVKeyMac.app/Contents/MacOS/EVKey executable I inspected as x86_64 only.
Homebrew specifies that EVKey 3.3.10 requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon and currently marks the cask disabled.

limitation: Apple Silicon runtime was not tested and the rolling GitHub release does not establish the release date for the current Mac version.
notes: The vendor still distributes the Mac build directly.

name: LZDoom
product: LZDoom Doom source port by drfrag666

evidence.says: The official Mac archive was posted March 8, 2022, and inspection found only x86_64 in LZDoom.app/Contents/MacOS/lzdoom version 3.88b.
The project release history shows 3.88b is the newest stable release with a Mac binary while subsequent stable releases ship Windows and Linux binaries.

limitation: No Rosetta 2 runtime confirmation for the exact 3.88b Mac binary was found.
notes: The fat Mach-O header has only one architecture slice.

name: SyncMate
product: SyncMate by Electronic Team (Eltima)

evidence.says: The vendor lists SyncMate 8.11.604 as its latest release, dated August 27, 2026.
Binary inspection of SyncMate.app/Contents/MacOS/SyncMate confirmed a universal x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O, with bundle ID com.eltima.SyncMate and build 8.11.604.

name: Adobe Dimension
product: Adobe Dimension by Adobe

evidence.says: Adobe lists Dimension 4.1.7, released January 21, 2026, as its latest stable release.
Adobe confirms that the current Dimension executable is Intel-only x86_64.
Adobe documents support for Apple Silicon Macs through emulation.

notes: Adobe has separately announced a redesigned Dimension beta that combines workflows from Dimension and Substance 3D Stager.

name: Balthisar Tidy
product: Balthisar Tidy (direct download) by Jim Derry

evidence.says: The developer documents Apple Silicon support for Balthisar Tidy 4.3.0 in May 2021.
The official disk image contains version 4.3.0 with the original bundle ID and a universal arm64 and x86_64 Contents/MacOS/Balthisar Tidy executable.

name: BitdefenderVirusScanner
product: Bitdefender Virus Scanner (free Mac App Store edition) by Bitdefender SRL

evidence.says: Apple’s store metadata identifies the exact bundle ID and lists current version 3.18, released December 4, 2024.
Rosetta Check’s Mac telemetry identifies version 3.18 of Bitdefender Virus Scanner as a Universal Binary.

limitation: Architecture is based on reported Mac telemetry and was not independently inspected.
notes: Bitdefender Virus Scanner Plus and Bitdefender Antivirus for Mac are separate products.

name: OpenMW-CS
product: OpenMW-CS (OpenMW Construction Set) by the OpenMW project

evidence.says: The OpenMW 0.51.0 release notes include the OpenMW-CS editor and identify its separate macOS application bundle.

The release provides OpenMW-0.51.0-macOS-arm64.dmg, in which inspection of OpenMW-CS.app version 0.51.0 confirmed bundle ID org.openmw.opencs and a Mach-O arm64 main executable at Contents/MacOS/OpenMW-CS.

notes: OpenMW-CS is the mod and content editor distributed with OpenMW.

name: Package Central
product: Package Central for Adobe InDesign by Zevrix Solutions

evidence.says: Zevrix identifies the current Package Central 2 product as Apple Silicon native.
Zevrix lists Package Central 2.1 as the current download and retains 1.14.2 under legacy versions.
The official changelog identifies Package Central 2 as the paid upgrade of the original application.

limitation: The exact 2.1 release date and whether the 2.1 binary also contains an Intel slice are unverified.
notes: The 2021 scan was from the legacy 1.x line.

name: Product Hunt
product: Product Hunt for Mac menu-bar client by Product Hunt

evidence.says: Product Hunt calls this its official Mac client, and the owner archived its repository on February 21, 2023.
The final archived source tree identifies the app as version 1.0.3.

limitation: The architecture and release date of the final 1.0.3 build were not established.
notes: The archived repository still links to a historical DMG.

name: EPSON Manuals
product: EPSON Manuals component of Epson printer software

evidence.says: Epson shows EPSON Manuals as an optional component in the Mac printer setup disk’s Install Navi screen.
Epson shows an Epson Manuals control in the Epson Edge Dashboard printer status screen.

limitation: The original printer model and the architecture of its manuals component are unverified.
notes: This listing represents access to hardware manuals.

name: StellarPlayerForMac
product: Stellar Player (恒星播放器) for Mac by Lenghu Technology (Wuhan) Co., Ltd.

evidence.says: Cold Lake’s official homepage offers its standard Mac version through the Mac App Store.
Apple’s storefront metadata matches cn.coldlake.stellar and identifies the current Mac release as 4.000, dated July 20, 2026.

limitation: Neither official listing identifies the executable architecture of version 4.000, and the Mac App Store binary was not available for inspection.

name: Clipto
product: Clipto desktop clipboard and notes app by Clipto Pro

evidence.says: The final official desktop release lists clipto-7.2.17.dmg, which contains Clipto.app version 7.2.17 with bundle ID clipto and an x86_64-only executable at Contents/MacOS/Clipto.
Users on the project's tracker document that maintenance stopped, the Android listing was removed, and subscription payments ceased.

limitation: Rosetta 2 runtime behavior was not verified.
notes: The final Mac installer remains downloadable on GitHub.

name: Guarda
product: Guarda Desktop Wallet by Guarda

evidence.says: Guarda lists and links the official Mac disk image for desktop wallet version 1.1.1 without documenting its architecture.
The versioned release lists a single macOS disk image of 189 MiB without an architecture label.

limitation: The architecture of the current desktop build is undocumented in the sources checked, and the installer exceeds the binary inspection size limit.

name: HRSword
product: HRSword for Mac (火绒剑 Mac 版) by Huorong Security

evidence.says: Huorong identifies HRSword for Mac as its system analysis utility and dates the version 1.0 public beta to May 12, 2021.
The official disk image contains HRSword.app version 1.0.0.0 build 165 with bundle ID cn.huorong.HRSword and an x86_64-only main executable at Contents/MacOS/HRSword.

limitation: Rosetta 2 operation of the app and its system extension was not verified.

name: File Viewer
product: File Viewer for macOS (legacy desktop edition) by Sharpened Productions

evidence.says: Sharpened calls its macOS File Viewer legacy software and says it is no longer actively maintained.
The Mac platform’s App Store page lists version 1.4 dated November 19, 2013.
The historical scan for com.sharpened.FileViewer version 1.4 records X86 as its supported architecture.

notes: The original Mac release remains available for free. The default App Store view shows the modern iPhone and iPad edition.

name: Picascade
product: Picascade, an Electron Mac bundle of unverified origin

evidence.says: The historical scan records an Electron-style bundle identifier and a Picascade 1.0.0 executable without vendor metadata.

limitation: The publisher, purpose, current distribution and architecture could not be established from the scan, repository search or Mac App Store search.
notes: Category is provisional pending identification.

name: Shadowsocks
product: Original ShadowsocksX for macOS by clowwindy

evidence.says: The original upstream repository says the project was removed according to regulations.
The original project still serves ShadowsocksX 2.6.3 as an archival Mac DMG, published June 28, 2015.
The cask for the upstream 2.6.3 artifact says it is Intel-only and requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.
Robert Yim publishes a separate 2.6.5 release, which explains the higher version seen in the scan.

limitation: The Rosetta caveat covers upstream 2.6.3, and runtime was not tested.
notes: The scanned version 2.6.5 matches the later third-party build. ShadowsocksX-NG is a separate client.

name: CueMix FX
product: MOTU CueMix FX mixer and DSP control application

evidence.says: MOTU lists Audio Installer 1.7+11ea3df24, released January 13, 2026, as the current Mac download for the Audio Express.
I inspected CueMix FX.app/Contents/MacOS/CueMix FX in this installer, which matches com.motu.CueMixFX at version 1.7 11ea3df24 and contains x86_64 and arm64 slices.

limitation: Runtime with a supported MOTU interface was not tested.
notes: CueMix FX is bundled with the legacy hardware installer and is distinct from CueMix 5 and CueMix Pro.

name: MOTU Audio Setup
product: MOTU Audio Setup control application for legacy MOTU interfaces

evidence.says: MOTU lists Audio Installer 1.7+11ea3df24, released January 13, 2026, as the current Mac download for the Audio Express.
I inspected MOTU Audio Setup.app/Contents/MacOS/MOTU Audio Setup at version 1.7 11ea3df24 with x86_64 and arm64 slices and the new bundle identifier com.motu.Project.
MOTU documents MOTU Audio Setup as the hardware settings app included in the Audio Express installer.

limitation: Runtime with a supported MOTU interface was not tested.
notes: The vendor now ships the same-named hardware setup utility under com.motu.Project.

name: MOTU SMPTE Setup
product: MOTU SMPTE Setup timecode application for legacy MOTU interfaces

evidence.says: MOTU lists Audio Installer 1.7+11ea3df24, released January 13, 2026, as the current Mac download for the Audio Express.
I inspected MOTU SMPTE Setup.app/Contents/MacOS/MOTU SMPTE Setup at version 1.7 11ea3df24 with x86_64 and arm64 slices and the new bundle identifier com.motu.ClockWorks.
MOTU documents MOTU SMPTE Setup as the SMPTE timecode control app included in the Audio Express installer.

limitation: Runtime with a supported MOTU interface was not tested.
notes: The vendor now ships the same-named SMPTE utility under com.motu.ClockWorks.

name: ZDoom
product: ZDoom Doom engine source port by Randy Heit

evidence.says: Heit’s official repository lists the final stable ZDoom 2.8.1 tag from February 22, 2016.
The article quotes Heit’s January 2017 announcement that there would be no further ZDoom versions.
Mac Source Ports lists the historical ZDoom 2.8.1 Mac build as Universal 1 for Intel and PowerPC Macs.

limitation: The archived 2.8.1 Mac executable was not inspected.
notes: The reported architectures of the final Mac build exclude Apple Silicon. GZDoom and LZDoom are distinct forks.

name: Icons8
product: Pichon for macOS (formerly Icons8.app) by Icons8

evidence.says: Icons8 support identifies the original com.visualpharm.Icons8 preference domain as belonging to Pichon for Mac.
Icons8 describes native ARM support as an update to the existing Pichon app.
The official standalone disk image contains Pichon.app version 1.12.0 build 224 with a universal x86_64 and arm64 main executable at Contents/MacOS/Pichon.

notes: The current direct-download app uses com.icons8.Pichon and tracks a different version series from the Mac App Store edition.

name: LEGO Star Wars II Demo
product: LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy Mac demo by Feral Interactive

evidence.says: A May 3, 2007 launch report identifies Feral's Mac demo and its PowerPC G4 and Intel requirements.
The original Mach-O scan for the exact com.feral.starwars demo version 1.0 records 32-bit Intel and PowerPC slices.
Apple documents that 32-bit apps cannot run on macOS Catalina or later.

notes: This listing covers the original Mac demo.

name: Pd
product: Pure Data (Pd Vanilla) by Miller Puckette and the Pure Data project

evidence.says: Miller Puckette lists 0.57-0 as the current stable release and links its Mac download.
Miller Puckette announced the availability of Pd 0.57-0 on October 5, 2026.
Binary inspection of Pd-0.57-0.app inside the shipped DMG found both x86_64 and arm64 slices in Contents/MacOS/Pd and Contents/Resources/bin/pd.

notes: The current bundle uses info.puredata.pd.pd-gui in place of the historical org.puredata.pd.pd-gui identifier.

name: Performer Lite
product: Performer Lite digital audio workstation by MOTU

evidence.says: MOTU identifies 11.37+103003, released November 18, 2026, as the current Mac build of Performer Lite 11.
MOTU documents Apple Silicon as a supported processor and says Performer Lite 11 runs on it without Rosetta.

limitation: MOTU documents native support for the 11 series, and the 11.37 installer exceeds the binary inspection size limit.
notes: Performer Lite is bundled with qualifying MOTU hardware and is a separate app from Digital Performer.

name: MindMaster
product: Wondershare MindMaster for Mac, Chinese edition (now branded 万兴脑图)

evidence.says: Wondershare identifies 万兴脑图 as the continuation of its former 亿图脑图 product and shows 13.0.13 as the current Chinese Mac release, dated December 29, 2025.
Homebrew's version 13.0.13 cask installs the actual 亿图脑图MindMaster.app from the vendor's full disk image and flags that it requires Rosetta.

limitation: The Rosetta requirement comes from Homebrew. The full package exceeds the binary inspection limit.
notes: The small download on the product page is a separate installer. This result covers the Chinese Mac edition.

name: ShotPro
product: ShotPro 2021 for Mac by WebGames3D, renamed ShotPro S

evidence.says: WebGames3D says ShotPro S is the same product as ShotPro 2021 under a new name and distinguishes it from the Standalone edition.
The vendor offers a separate ShotPro S Mac download and gives OS requirements without naming the app architecture.

limitation: No versioned architecture statement for ShotPro S was found, and its Mac archive exceeds the binary inspection limit.
notes: ShotPro HQ and ShotPro Standalone are separate releases with incompatible project files.

name: App Language Chooser
product: App Language Chooser by CTM Development SA

evidence.says: Apple's catalog identifies the current macOS listing as CTM Development's com.ctmdev.App-Language-Chooser version 1.0 and dates it July 26, 2011.
The scan for version 1.0 records only 32-bit and 64-bit Intel slices.
An M1 Pro user reported opening the utility's window and dragging apps into it without the expected result.

limitation: An M1 Pro report establishes that the Intel app opens, with the language-switching workflow unverified and reported to fail on that machine.

name: TomieWGM
product: Tomie Wants to Get Married by Ollane

evidence.says: The original scan identifies the com.Ollane.TomieWGM macOS game build 0.69011 and reports an x86 executable.
The creator's Patreon page reports that it has been removed.
A third-party discussion identifies the game and developer and refers to a subsequent PC expansion release.

limitation: No reliable current official Mac release or architecture was located.

name: ngraph-gtk
product: Ngraph-GTK scientific graphing app by htrb

evidence.says: The official 6.09.07 release assets provide separate arm64 and x86_64 macOS disk images.
The developer's changelog dates 6.09.07 to February 9, 2023, and records the end of prebuilt macOS package distribution at 6.09.08.
The developer's Homebrew formula currently builds Ngraph-GTK 6.10.00 from source.

limitation: The native claim applies to the last official standalone macOS binary release, 6.09.07.
notes: Newer macOS versions of the software install from source through the developer's Homebrew tap, which can also install a separate launcher bundle.

name: Xoctave
product: Xoctave Mac bundle (publisher unverified)

evidence.says: The original upload records an executable called Xoctave in bundle org.magnifier.magnifier with CFBundleVersion 1.0 and a 32-bit Intel Mach-O slice.
Apple documents that the originally scanned 32-bit build cannot run on macOS Catalina or later.

limitation: The publisher and any current distribution channel for this exact bundle could not be established.
notes: Research surfaced a same-named commercial GNU Octave front end for Windows and Linux, with no evidence tying it to the scanned Mac bundle.

name: OfficeTime
product: OfficeTime for Mac by Productive Monkey Ltd

evidence.says: Productive Monkey says OfficeTime 3 is Apple Silicon native and links its current Mac download.
Binary inspection of OfficeTime.app/Contents/MacOS/OfficeTime confirmed a universal x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O with bundle ID net.officetime.officetime and CFBundleShortVersionString 3.046.

limitation: The vendor changelog stops at 3.0.44, so the release date of the downloaded build is unconfirmed.
notes: The inspected build number is 3.0.46.3.59.

name: DrPDF
product: Dr.PDF for Mac by iSeePassword

evidence.says: iSeePassword identifies its PDF password recovery product as Dr.PDF and links the Mac disk image.
Binary inspection of the linked disk image found a universal x86_64 and arm64 Dr.PDF.app/Contents/MacOS/Dr.PDF, with bundle version 7.0.0 and ID com.drpdf.app.

limitation: No release date was found for the version shipped in the current Mac download.
notes: The current vendor download uses com.drpdf.app in place of the historical com.iSeePassword.DrPDFMain. Version 7.0.0 comes from the shipped bundle metadata.

name: Seclore Lite Main
product: Seclore Lite for Mac, the Seclore desktop agent

evidence.says: Seclore’s macOS support documentation identifies Seclore Lite Main.app as an installed component of its Mac desktop agent.
The enterprise rollout guide describes deploying the Seclore for Mac agent using Seclore Lite.dmg.
The vendor installer guide identifies the exact Main.app bundle and distinguishes it from the installer and updater.

limitation: The current main bundle’s architecture and exact version were not established from public documentation, and no public current client installer was found.

name: Viveza 2
product: Viveza 2 for macOS, the legacy Nik Collection component by DxO

evidence.says: DxO’s Nik Collection 3.3 release notes document the Viveza 2 Mac standalone executable.
DxO’s Nik Collection 4 release notes document the redesigned Viveza in the later suite.
A user reports that installing Nik Collection 4 replaced Viveza 2 and that reinstalling Nik Collection 3 restored it.

limitation: The final Viveza 2 Mac build number and architecture were not verified.
notes: Viveza 2 had a standalone mode in Nik Collection 3. Its replacement was Viveza 3, now Nik Viveza.

name: Movavi Screen Recorder
product: Movavi Screen Recorder for Mac by Movavi

evidence.says: Movavi lists 24.8.2 as the current Mac release, dated September 30, 2026, and records that ARM hardware support was added in 24.5.0.
Movavi says the current Screen Recorder installs natively on Apple Silicon Macs.
Binary inspection of the package found an arm64 Mach-O at Movavi Screen Recorder.app/Contents/MacOS/ScreenRecorder, with version 24.8.2 and bundle ID com.movavi.screenrecorder.
Apple lists the same product at version 24.8.2 with the historical com.movavi.screencapture identifier.

limitation: The arm64 executable was confirmed for Movavi’s direct download and the Mac App Store binary was not inspected.
notes: The small public web installer is a separate app bundle. September 30 is the direct-release date from Movavi.
